ns0:entry.ns0:title: [箭厂ArrowFactory Doc]WeChat Briefly Tested Visitor Logs. China Exploded.

ns2:group.ns2:title: WeChat Briefly Tested Visitor Logs. China Exploded.
ns2:group.ns2:description: WeChat briefly tested a feature showing how many people viewed a user's status, and Chinese social media immediately exploded. Unlike WhatsApp, WeChat in China mixes work, family, and close friends all in one app. Many users see visitor logs and read receipts as crossing a social boundary. #Tencent shut the test down within hours. Its PR chief later said such features are "permanently welded shut" and will never be introduced. #wechat #tencent #whatsappstatus #whatsapp #socialmedia @WeChatApp

ns2:group.ns2:title: Xingkong TV to suspend satellite broadcast service
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Xingkong TV says its satellite broadcast service will be suspended from May 8 due to operational difficulties, as the channel seeks strategic investors and restructuring opportunities.
Officially launched in March 2002 under Rupert Murdoch’s STAR Group, the Mandarin-language channel was once known for variety and entertainment programming during China’s early satellite TV boom.
The broadcaster says it is exploring asset sales, platform partnerships and brand transformation options.
#Television #MediaIndustry #SatelliteTV #China
